romanizationKeyboard.comment: Section header for the romanization keyboard layouts (host tab + IME layout overlay).

customLayoutsSection.comment: Section header above the custom-layout shelf on the Layout tab and in the in-keyboard layout picker.

createNewLayout.comment: Label + content description for the create-new-layout card on the custom-layout shelf.

editorTitleNew.comment: Layout editor top-bar title in create mode; also the name-field placeholder and the name a layout saved with a blank name gets. Edit mode shows the layout's own name.

nameHeader.comment: Layout name alert header, shown on Save in the layout editor.

commonLayoutsSection.comment: Section header on the Layout tab for layouts whose keys are the same in Tâi-lô and Pe̍h-ōe-jī.

standardLayout.comment: Layout name: the standard QWERTY-style romanization layout (Lohankha).

phahTaigiLayout.comment: Layout name: the PhahTaigi romanization layout.

tpsLayout.comment: Layout name: the Taiwanese Phonetic Symbols (TPS) keyboard.

moe1Layout.comment: Layout name: MOE Taiwanese romanization key arrangement, variant 1.

moe2Layout.comment: Layout name: MOE Taiwanese romanization key arrangement, variant 2.
